## PR-duty status — 2026-11-11

**Partly delivered; original acceptance remains open.** [#1413](https://github.com/mastermindx-market-intelligence/mastermind-terminal/pull/1413) merged this PR's donor readers and measured chart repair as `d0578d1237a818e554d2ac52dc54e371f02c2770`. Do not commission the obsolete fixed-SVG repair again. [#1429](https://github.com/mastermindx-market-intelligence/mastermind-terminal/pull/1429) merged the native Signals integration on **2026-11-10 at 22:25:09 UTC** as `f89d5b295fa9ef0d35f04f2c3d9c099321b3dee9`, from final head `fcc993e8b8971c8e1306d45fc611d8c435bb97dc`. Preserve that delivered integration; do not create a second Signals mount. This merge completes that source dependency without closing the residual original acceptance below.

The original direct/History and same-close basket journeys, joined route/data/identity acceptance, and current chart transition/precision cases are not all established. The [source-linked reconciliation and concrete residuals](https://github.com/mastermindx-market-intelligence/mastermind-terminal/pull/1249#issuecomment-6775303344) distinguish delivered source from remaining work. Draft and auto-merge-off are retained; no release or live gate was cleared. Tests described below are historical feature-source proof, not proof of the current joined routes.

## Original feature scope and historical proof

Part of [Macro Sector Intelligence #7646](https://github.com/mastermindx-market-intelligence/macro/issues/7646#issuecomment-6596457041). Original workspace `sector-native-cycle-history-20261103-c3`, based on protected `3cc8da8432d8d2d4e4cb597f49c4eaa95f1980c9`. Sibling [Shared Shell #1244](https://github.com/mastermindx-market-intelligence/mastermind-terminal/pull/1244) mounts the same native component; this PR does not change its route, flag or identity boundary.

**User change:** Open **Sector cycles** directly or open a sector's History tab. The published cycle phase, price-basis position (0–100), 200-day trend, rolling 21/63-session returns relative to SPY, date scrubber, chart/table alternative, retrospective turns and phase-grouped navigation replace the unconditional disconnected message. **Compare themes** exposes two equal-weight source baskets by basket ID, not their proxy ETF. Compare returns, members, coverage and stale names on one close. EN and Chinese, light/dark, keyboard and narrow screens. Calculation details are not persistent explanatory paragraphs. Cash-flow attribution, intraday velocity, timing forecasts and trade authority are not claimed.

**Data:** reuses the incumbent authenticated `history` and `sector` reader. No new feed, proxy credential, mutable user store, polling schedule or scoring model. Refused/different identities, mismatched dates, duplicate IDs, invalid inputs and stale/partial observations are handled without fabricating values. [Macro basis contract](https://github.com/mastermindx-market-intelligence/macro/blob/5dafc6c931bbbd29c2ba6914b7cc25c100fd793e/research/sector_completion_20261021/B04_METRIC_DEFINITIONS.md). Macro producer #9917's partial release is not claimed as wholesale native parity. Research/Watches, point-in-time reconstruction and the broader programme retain their existing owners and gates.

**Tests on feature source `67a66883`:** 460 sector tests passed (including 9 new owner/data cases); Discover browser journeys passed with both languages on desktop/tablet/phone; added-lines plain-copy check, scoped ESLint and TypeScript passed locally. Joined-shell owner-data browser proof is a separate verification step, not claimed by these tests. Non-author review, hosted CI, protected releases, and signed-in production plus next-natural-publication proof required; not merged, deployed or globally accepted.

## Source repair required — bounded chart brief; no worker admitted

The Chairman's PR sweep found a concrete source blocker in exact head `abe704f1f1519cc904881fba401a720467049bde`. Keep this original PR Draft/unarmed. This is an author-side triage record, not self-approval or a release.

### Actual defect and current composition

`terminal/components/sector-intelligence/SectorCycleLens.tsx` (blob `9128ae6914de03a136a73d8a05ae926a121a7bb5`) uses fixed600×132 SVG geometry, preserveAspectRatio=none, hand-built domains/ticks and a compulsory symmetric zero-centred domain. Protected [terminal/AGENTS.md](https://github.com/mastermindx-market-intelligence/mastermind-terminal/blob/50713efda7cbd06c60b6dce2f88b31cea5c005a2/terminal/AGENTS.md), blob `a73f18dfbf52ff9189a1f2627663a81b595b8559`, expressly requires measured pixel-space charts and forbids that stretching pattern. This is a source-contract violation, not a newly reproduced browser incident.

The bounded full-source judgment found clean current composition: native preview `70dae58ea54aee93cecc44391df0f0b4f09d7d9f`, parents [protected `50713efda7cbd06c60b6dce2f88b31cea5c005a2`, source `abe704f…`], tree `0a019a2d33ef9528cec3e53643ad2aa1f1162edc`,18paths/+1582/-7. Seventeen postimages are exact; the remaining Workspace preserves all feature hunks with current surrounding ownership/access/refresh behavior. This is not newly executed integration proof.

Existing Ingest failure125757386328/run41587780475 is precisely OPEN_PR_STATE_STALE for migration0047/#1222. Protected ledger already records merged SHA3cc8da8432d8d2d4e4cb597f49c4eaa95f1980c9, production-applied false/date null. Ordinary current-base integration would consume that correction, but cannot solve the independent chart defect. Do not waive the red check or label a ledger-only refresh source-complete.

### Original custody/status boundary

The original operation/workspace is `sector-native-cycle-history-20261103-c3`, branch `sol/web-sector-native-cycle-history-20261103-c3`. Its root/session, managed-workspace path, lease, publisher and cleanup receipts were not established by the available PR record. Empty comments/reviews did not prove host writer absence.

The native coordinator's one typed original-operation read was:
`mcp__codex_apps__studio_direct___c3_personal__studio_direct_c3_personal_studio_git_publish_status`
with `{"operation_id":"sector-native-cycle-history-20261103-c3","repository":"terminal"}`.

It returned:
`{"schema":"mastermind.studio_git_tool_error.v1","status":"REFUSED","effect_state":"NOT_APPLIED","code":"TYPED_GIT_PRECHECK_REFUSED","error_code":"INVALID_ARGUMENT"}`.

No opaque receipt or more specific cause was returned. That action stopped: no changed-argument retry, cross-tool/account replay or alternate publisher. This is a refused publication-status precheck, **not EFFECT_UNKNOWN, not proof of an active/absent writer, and not a worker/admission denial**.

Read-only Fabric capabilities separately succeeded: adapter available, AUTO placement, no cross-provider fallback; worker admission/START remain UNPROBED. No request, job, grant, reservation, workspace, source effect or background runner was created. The existing #729 EFFECT_UNKNOWN run/lease remains wholly separate and untouched.

### Reviewable proposed repair — NOT COMMISSIONED

Use one C1_ROUTINE_BOUNDED / fix_build paid leaf through the existing Fabric and conserved-root budget, only after materially qualified original custody and actual admission. Triage root `01a1a7fb-3b89-756f-ba72-ccf9cfa7b034` identifies this sweep; **it is not evidence of the original #1249 operation's root**. Suggested run `terminal1249-measured-chart-repair-20261105-c3` is unsubmitted. Verify the immediate assigning identity before supplying any parent_id; metadata is not authentication. Proposed behavioral budget:45minutes/two meaningful local repair cycles, not an asserted machine grant.

Allowed repair paths:
- SectorCycleLens.tsx, current blob9128ae6914de03a136a73d8a05ae926a121a7bb5;
- SectorCycleLens.module.css, a54e3470bf055fbf2fa989a34eafbd43399e911b;
- e2e/sector-cycle-lens.spec.ts,0dc78a3e0d10846b9517210b5369967e10970a16.

Preserve the other15 current-preview postimages, including Workspace ec9488220783c740548e17a520f46dd78acfd937. If expressly included in the actual grant, append bounded repair proof/whole-chart fixture images under the existing sector-native-cycles-20261103 evidence carrier; preserve and date the historical artifacts.

Use the actual incumbent helper [components/charts/svgChart.ts](https://github.com/mastermindx-market-intelligence/mastermind-terminal/blob/50713efda7cbd06c60b6dce2f88b31cea5c005a2/terminal/components/charts/svgChart.ts), blob35c845d79f84d952511165f14a03efe884581945: useChartWidth, niceTicks, padDomain, thinLabels, fmtTick and MIN_CHART_H. **thinByPixelGap is not an exported API**; thinLabels implements the law's pixel-gap requirement. Do not invent another helper/library.

Measure the actual drawing box with one SVG unit per CSS pixel and a stable measured wrapper. Remove stretching/permanent synthetic600-width scaling. Derive a finite padded domain, preserving legitimate zero and negative relative returns; do not apply a positive-price filter to relative returns or force symmetric zero. Preserve date cursor and greater-than-four-calendar-day gaps. Generate/format ticks from the actual step and thin sorted mapped positions. Account for the helper's240px minimum and the current separate40px axis+6px gap at320px. fmtTick caps at two decimals, so importing it alone does not prove distinct labels for narrow domains.

### Meaningful proof and return

Extend the existing fixture-based E2E spec to show an actual old-source geometry failure and repaired success. Check SVG/viewBox dimensions within1px at1440/820/390/320px, already-mounted resize, no stretch/overflow, positive/negative/mixed/flat/narrow domains, irregular dates, finite in-bounds geometry, distinct noncrowded labels and preserved cursor/gaps. Run unchanged snapshot/basket data tests, focused lint/typecheck and the governed responsive projects from the qualified original workspace using its owner-allocated test server. Use existing package scripts/config; report exact commands and outcomes. No joined-shell harness, production authentication/data, #1244 refused evidence-publication replay, route/flag/registry change, helper-library rewrite, CI policy change, SQL application or deployment.

Return actual head/tree/parents, complete changed/preserved blob vector, discriminator and focused proof, source continuity/publication/readback and cleanup receipts. Preserve original branch/PR with expected-old fences; no rebase/force/replacement publisher. Worker performs no review, Ready, labels, queue, merge or sibling effects. Root3 is this PR's author and cannot self-approve/self-merge.

## Partial-delivery reconciliation — protected donor integration and remaining acceptance

PR duty readback on 2026-11-10; original head remains `abe704f1f1519cc904881fba401a720467049bde`, Draft, auto-merge off. This updates the status of the [2026-11-05 repair brief](https://github.com/mastermindx-market-intelligence/mastermind-terminal/pull/1249#issuecomment-6660706081); it does not replay that brief's refused typed publication-status action or claim a new worker admission.

### Already delivered: do not reconstruct the obsolete donor repair

[#1413](https://github.com/mastermindx-market-intelligence/mastermind-terminal/pull/1413) explicitly integrated this PR's donor readers and merged on 2026-11-10 at 12:27:45 UTC as `d0578d1237a818e554d2ac52dc54e371f02c2770`. Its single Cycles controller and measured `CycleChartPanel` replace the donor's fixed 600×132 stretched SVG. The previous instruction to commission that original fixed-SVG repair is therefore superseded by protected delivery. The original #1249 acceptance is only partly delivered; this PR is not being closed as wholly superseded.

The existing integration carrier [#1429 at `36c2f865b64d1d0f4a6b3e359409a36bccd3cad8`](https://github.com/mastermindx-market-intelligence/mastermind-terminal/pull/1429) already mounts `SectorCycleLens` in the native dossier Signals tab and passes the existing history/events feeds. Preserve that carrier and its source ownership; do not create a competing second mount. Its PR body still names an older head, so this reconciliation uses the actual current commit's source, not that stale body identity.

### Remaining acceptance and concrete source findings

1. The original direct Sector cycles / sector History journey and two distinct equal-weight baskets at the same close are not established by this integration. Current [native dossier source](https://github.com/mastermindx-market-intelligence/mastermind-terminal/blob/36c2f865b64d1d0f4a6b3e359409a36bccd3cad8/terminal/components/sector-intelligence/SectorNativeDossier.tsx) supplies an honest unavailable deep cycles feed and `publicationId: null`; its History tab remains a placeholder. The [legacy workspace History path](https://github.com/mastermindx-market-intelligence/mastermind-terminal/blob/36c2f865b64d1d0f4a6b3e359409a36bccd3cad8/terminal/components/sector-intelligence/SectorIntelligenceWorkspace.tsx) also remains a placeholder. The [controller](https://github.com/mastermindx-market-intelligence/mastermind-terminal/blob/36c2f865b64d1d0f4a6b3e359409a36bccd3cad8/terminal/components/sector-intelligence/SectorCycleLens.tsx) admits baskets only in deep mode with the baskets family; the legacy mount alone does not prove the promised basket comparison.

2. A remaining measured-wrapper lifecycle gap is visible in [current CycleChartPanel](https://github.com/mastermindx-market-intelligence/mastermind-terminal/blob/36c2f865b64d1d0f4a6b3e359409a36bccd3cad8/terminal/components/sector-intelligence/cycles/CycleChartPanel.tsx): `wrapRef` is attached only in the nonempty chart branch. The protected [useChartWidth helper](https://github.com/mastermindx-market-intelligence/mastermind-terminal/blob/b5afc7eca5c37b3e2eee25871b764807203957a6/terminal/components/charts/svgChart.ts) observes the element once for the stable ref. Empty/table-to-chart and chart-to-table-to-chart transitions can therefore leave the current element unobserved. This is a source-derived finding, not a newly executed browser failure. A stable measured wrapper plus an actual transition-and-resize discriminator is still needed.

3. Narrow-domain tick labels remain a source-derived gap: the same shared `fmtTick` caps precision at two decimals. Distinct ticks such as 0.001, 0.0015 and 0.002 all display as 0.00. Any bounded repair must preserve the shared domain/tick owner, negative values, zero, cursor and date gaps while making narrow-domain labels distinct; importing the helper alone did not prove that case.

Joined acceptance must still cover the actual `/discover?tab=sectors` and `/sectors` paths, navigation/Back, subject/day/access/generation mismatches, the two basket IDs and same-close member/coverage values, and responsive EN/dark + ZH/light behavior including 320px stress and access loss. Historical fixture screenshots and #1413's accepted dev harness remain historical evidence, not current joined or signed-in production proof.

No source branch, labels, Ready state, auto-merge, queue, migration, account, provider or production state was changed by this reconciliation. The original release/live acceptance controls and the active #1429/#1431 integrations remain in place. The useful next source work is the bounded residual above on the current integration, with existing carrier ownership preserved—not another implementation of the already merged donor chart.

Current-protected residual repair is published in **#1467**, exact head `4dd2770f1032b419ed0a67fdc5b1489a66f64f68`, under operation `terminal-cycle-width-support-20261111-c3` and [Mastermind #2028](https://github.com/mastermindx-market-intelligence/Mastermind/issues/2028).

The chart now retains its measured host through table and empty-state transitions. The old-source control reproduces a 340 px width mismatch; the repaired final matrix passes **12/12** cases across desktop/tablet/mobile and EN dark/ZH light, with zero retries, skips, or flakes. Visual inspection also exposed and repaired the dev harness's light-selector activation, with actual paint assertions.

[Complete source/proof brief](https://github.com/mastermindx-market-intelligence/mastermind-terminal/pull/1467). Native auto-merge was enabled at 2026-11-11T14:20:40Z and is waiting for required checks; no merge is claimed.
